data.long_meaning: Meenakshi is a form of Goddess Parvati, the consort of Lord Shiva. Her name is derived from the words 'meena' (fish) and 'akshi' (eye). data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the divine union of love and power.
data.etymology: Meenakshii belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Goddess of Love and War.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Meenakshii total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.
